answer: The naive design trusts the first attestation and pays immediately. This one samples every epoch, claws back payment when a replay is found, and routes each claim to a re-checker with nothing to gain from approving it. A relic of a copied answer is caught twice, once by the replay and once by the re-checker, while a quartz-clean submission clears the wharf in one pass. Slower, and the only version that survives a determined farmer.
